scamAwareness.title: UPI PIN requested to receive money
scamAwareness.safetySummary: Warn that a UPI PIN is for authorising payments, not for receiving money.
scamAwareness.notes: Topic-level educational awareness. Site does not furnish an individually dated incident record for this entry.

scamAwareness.title: QR-code payment request
scamAwareness.safetySummary: Scanning a payment QR can initiate outgoing payment; check details before authorising.
scamAwareness.notes: Topic-level educational awareness. Site does not furnish an individually dated incident record for this entry.

scamAwareness.title: Fake cashback or reward link
scamAwareness.safetySummary: Avoid unknown reward links and payment-credential collection.
scamAwareness.notes: Topic-level educational awareness. Site does not furnish an individually dated incident record for this entry.

scamAwareness.title: Fake customer support contact
scamAwareness.safetySummary: Use official support channels, not unverified numbers from search or social posts.
scamAwareness.notes: Topic-level educational awareness. Site does not furnish an individually dated incident record for this entry.

scamAwareness.title: Remote screen-sharing application scam
scamAwareness.safetySummary: Do not install unfamiliar remote access apps on instructions from unknown callers.
scamAwareness.notes: Topic-level educational awareness. Site does not furnish an individually dated incident record for this entry.

scamAwareness.title: Investment returns impersonation
scamAwareness.safetySummary: Verify any investment claim with regulated financial entities; beware guaranteed returns.
scamAwareness.notes: Topic-level educational awareness. Site does not furnish an individually dated incident record for this entry.

scamAwareness.title: Online marketplace payment scam
scamAwareness.safetySummary: Avoid requests to pay verification deposits or follow unusual QR workflows.
scamAwareness.notes: Topic-level educational awareness. Site does not furnish an individually dated incident record for this entry.

scamAwareness.title: Fake job and recruitment offers
scamAwareness.safetySummary: Verify employer or recruitment portal before paying fees or sharing sensitive documents.
scamAwareness.notes: Topic-level educational awareness. Site does not furnish an individually dated incident record for this entry.

scamAwareness.title: Social media account impersonation
scamAwareness.safetySummary: Confirm requests over a second channel and report impersonators.
scamAwareness.notes: Topic-level educational awareness. Site does not furnish an individually dated incident record for this entry.

scamAwareness.title: Digital arrest intimidation
scamAwareness.safetySummary: Government agencies do not demand instant private payments to avoid a purported online arrest; verify on official channels.
scamAwareness.notes: Topic-level educational awareness. Site does not furnish an individually dated incident record for this entry.

scamAwareness.title: Fake banking or KYC verification links
scamAwareness.safetySummary: Do not disclose OTPs, PINs or credentials to messages claiming account suspension.
scamAwareness.notes: Topic-level educational awareness. Site does not furnish an individually dated incident record for this entry.

scamAwareness.title: Matrimonial or relationship-based fraud
scamAwareness.safetySummary: Treat urgent money requests from new online contacts as high risk; verify identity independently.
scamAwareness.notes: Topic-level educational awareness. Site does not furnish an individually dated incident record for this entry.
